title: Layout of favorites grid is not synced after cloning
line: A cloned panel's Application Launcher now shows its favorites in the same order as the original.
explanation: Kickoff, Kicker and Application Dashboard save their favorites ordering in kactivitymanagerd-statsrc under their applet id, not in the applet's config. Cloning a panel copies the config but not that entry, so the cloned launcher had no ordering and fell back to a guess that takes the launcher instance with the highest id, often a different (or even deleted) launcher. The shell now passes the old applet id to the new launcher when cloning a panel or switching between launcher alternatives, and the launcher copies the old applet's ordering groups (every activity plus global) to its own id.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: keep the favorites ordering when cloning a panel

Kicker-based launchers save their favorites ordering under their applet
id, so a cloned or swapped launcher had none and guessed it from another
instance. Pass the old applet id to the new one so it can import it.

BUG: 514303

applets/kicker, applets/kickoff: import the favorites ordering of the old applet

When a panel is cloned or a launcher is swapped for an alternative, the
new applet now gets the old applet's id and copies its favorites ordering
instead of guessing it from whichever other launcher instance came last.

BUG: 514303

patches.diff:
From fc935994dc275da68f4cab173423246e5d5fb050 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 02:01:53 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kicker, applets/kickoff: import the favorites
 ordering of the old applet

When a panel is cloned or a launcher is swapped for an alternative, the
new applet now gets the old applet's id and copies its favorites ordering
instead of guessing it from whichever other launcher instance came last.

BUG: 514303
---
 applets/kicker/main.qml  | 2 ++
 applets/kickoff/main.qml | 2 ++
 2 files changed, 4 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/kicker/main.qml b/applets/kicker/main.qml
index 5c71937b15..83f1fee270 100644
--- a/applets/kicker/main.qml
+++ b/applets/kicker/main.qml
@@ -39,6 +39,8 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
     Plasmoid.icon: Plasmoid.configuration.useCustomButtonImage ? Plasmoid.configuration.customButtonImage : Plasmoid.configuration.icon
 
+    onExternalData: (mimetype, pluginId) => globalFavorites.importOrderingFromApplet(pluginId, Plasmoid.id, "org.kde.plasma.kicker")
+
     onSystemFavoritesChanged: {
         if (systemFavorites) {
             systemFavorites.favorites = Plasmoid.configuration.favoriteSystemActions;
diff --git a/applets/kickoff/main.qml b/applets/kickoff/main.qml
index 6b6c95dabe..e04e643666 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/main.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/main.qml
@@ -184,6 +184,8 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     readonly property int minimumGridRowCount: Math.min(Screen.desktopAvailableWidth, Screen.desktopAvailableHeight) * Screen.devicePixelRatio < KickoffSingleton.gridCellSize * 4 + (fullRepresentationItem ? fullRepresentationItem.normalPage.preferredSideBarWidth : KickoffSingleton.gridCellSize * 2) ? 2 : 4
     //END
 
+    onExternalData: (mimetype, pluginId) => rootModel.favoritesModel.importOrderingFromApplet(pluginId, Plasmoid.id, "org.kde.plasma.kickoff")
+
     Plasmoid.icon: Plasmoid.configuration.icon
 
     preferredRepresentation: compactRepresentation
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: the original Kickoff shows Chrome, System Settings, Dolphin, Discover; the clone made with Clone Panel shows them reversed (taken from a different launcher instance).
With the fix: the clone shows the same order as the original.

review.text: The approach (pass the old applet id via createApplet args, copy the kactivitymanagerd-statsrc ordering groups) works, and the three corrections over the original are real bugs. But it is a squash of Christoph Wolk's open MRs plasma-workspace!6632 and plasma-desktop!3730, so submitting it separately would compete with work that is already under review.
changes: Offer the three fixes (launcher-only alternatives check, per-activity group copy instead of saveOrdering, debug/semicolon cleanup) as review comments or suggested changes on !6632 and !3730, keeping Christoph as author, instead of a new MR
